responsibility: Implements command-line option handling for the C, C++, Objective-C, and Objective-C++ front ends. It parses and defers C-family options from c.opt, configures cpp_options and include-path behavior, selects language standards and dialect flags, sets up diagnostic defaults and charset handling, manages preprocessing-only and dump-related callbacks, and performs post-option sanitation and final front-end setup before parsing begins.
